PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak squat bench deadlift for meet day"

PHASES
  PHASE "Peaking Block" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Heavy Squat and Bench":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 4x3 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Heavy Deadlift and Bench Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 70m "Squat Volume and Bench Technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 7 rest 210 seconds
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Heavy Singles Squat and Bench":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x2 rpe 8.5 rest 270 seconds
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 8.5 rest 240 seconds
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Heavy Deadlift":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x2 rpe 8.5 rest 270 seconds
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Opener Practice":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2 rpe 7 rest 210 seconds
          bench_press 3x2 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 7 rest 210 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Final Heavy Touches":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Light Primer":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 2x2 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Saturday rest 20m "Meet Day Activation and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_circles 60 seconds
          arm_circles 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 120 seconds
